comparables.description: Indonesian mature oil palm with mill access

methodology:
Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is the largest SGX-listed palm operator with 500K+ hectares across 11 Indonesian provinces (Sumatra, Kalimantan, Papua) plus integrated downstream refining + consumer brand operations.

4-row breakdown:
- Sumatra core (645K acres / ~261K ha planted across Riau, North Sumatra, Jambi, Lampung, South Sumatra, Bangka-Belitung)
- Kalimantan (470K acres / ~190K ha across all 4 Kalimantan provinces)
- Papua + minor (207K acres / ~84K ha — smaller and newer cluster)
- Downstream / brand placeholder

The downstream segment (Filma, Mitra brands; refining + bulk distribution) is the largest of any palm operator in the comp set. Per-acre values for Papua reflect concession-stage + younger plantings discount.
